_comment: Pinned list-price table for cost accounting. Prices are USD per 1M tokens at the providers' standard (non-cached, non-batch) tier. This table is a measurement input: its source and pin date are sealed into every run artifact (pricing_source / pricing_date), so a cost figure is always traceable to the table that produced it. Update by bumping 'date' and 'source' together — never silently.
basis: USD per 1M tokens, list price, standard tier (no prompt caching, no batch discount, no long-context surcharge)

claude-fable-5-1._note: Frontier-ceiling pick (2026-09-25): $10/$50 per 1M, verified against multiple Sept-2026 sources (Anthropic pricing page, MacRumors 2026-09-01 launch coverage). Model id 'claude-fable-5-1' confirmed on the Claude API, GA 2026-09-01. Caveat: Fable 5.1 rejects forced tool_choice (400) — the current AnthropicAdapter forced-tool path cannot drive it; native output_config.format structured outputs is the documented route. Opt-in via AnthropicAdapter(model="claude-fable-5-1") only after that migration.

convaiinnovations/laya._note: Self-hosted checkpoint (LayaAdapter default): no API cost. Local inference cost is unaccounted in this table — prices at 0.0, explicitly unaccounted, never silently estimated.

jev-1.13.0._note: Secondary-sourced Jev pricing: $0.042 per 1M input tokens, output free ("too cheap to meter") — reported via gateway announcements (Vercel/Netlify/Spring AI, Sept 2026; e.g. https://vercel.com/kb/guide/typesafe-jev-and-ai-sdk), not confirmed on an official TypeSafe pricing page as of 2026-09-23. Re-verify before launch.

source: Pre-launch provisional prices (2026-09-23). GPT-5.6 tiers verified 2026-09-23 against https://openai.com/api/pricing/ (post 2026-07-30 price cut); Claude Sonnet 5 corrected 2026-09-23 to $2/$10 against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (the scheduled Sep-2026 rise to $3/$15 was cancelled); Jev $0.042/1M in / free out is secondary-sourced (gateway announcements), not confirmed on an official TypeSafe page. Claude/Gemini entries carried over from the pre-A2 table, unverified — re-verify every rate before launch. 2026-09-25: added claude-fable-5-1 ($10/$50, frontier-ceiling pick, rate verified against Sept-2026 sources), kimi-k3 ($3/$15, Moonshot API list price verified 2026-09-25), and $0 self-hosted entries for convaiinnovations/laya, convaiinnovations/laya-multilingual, convaiinnovations/laya-typed-decisions, the four jaredpalmer/kev Hub ids (0.5b/0.6b/4b/8b), Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (semif), and Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (openjev-sglang) — local inference cost unaccounted; ids match the sibling lane's pinned adapter MODEL_IDs as of 2026-09-25.
